verdict.rationale: YYLO documents a Parallel Runner that provides bounded concurrent fan-out across independent kanban tasks, data items or commands, with structured evidence for each item. Its Advanced mode adds isolated per-task worktrees and managed merging, explicitly for managed parallel development. Together these cover the core of running many agent tasks at once. Missing for 10: detail on concurrency limits and scaling behavior beyond 'bounded', clarity that real parallelism requires the Advanced topology setup, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that concurrent runs work at scale.
